last_result.headline: N8 negative at every azimuth tolerance; no submission. The no-filter control is byte-exact against the banked field (8.8626, -0.0000). The filter removes the NEAREST well for 10.9-12.2% of targets, but the deployed selection is already azimuth-coherent (median neighbour spread 26.7 deg), so all four variants lose (-0.0697 to -0.0789 pooled) and all fail the 3-well gate (5th -0.86..-0.90, P(gain>0) ~0.49). Confirms the N2 risk: the neighbourhood is effectively single-well. Together with N5 (membership) and N2 (referencing), the structural field is now probed on three axes and unchanged on all three.
